integrity: The proof combines the published stable-pair decomposition and fibre descriptions with the published classification of the intersection of the two components of Hilb^{2t+2}(P^3). The key dimension step uses only properness/dominance and the fibre-dimension theorem; generic preservation under the forgetful map is justified by the published criterion h^0(E(1))=1 for nonplanar associated schemes.
scientific_limitations: The result computes the set-theoretic dimension of the intersection of the two irreducible components of M(-1,2,2). It does not prove irreducibility of that intersection and does not determine its scheme structure, multiplicities, or local intersection singularities.
title: The two components of \(\mathcal M(-1,2,2)\) meet in dimension \(10\)
